title: Nodose ganglia, fasted_regular chow_male1, biol rep 1
extract_protocol_ch1: Total RNA was extracted using the RNAqueous Micro Total RNA isolation Kit (ThermoFisher), following the manufacturer's protocol. The quality of the RNA was evaluated using a Bioanalyzer 2100 with the RNA nano chip (Agilent Technologies, Santa Clara, CA). | Following mRNA enrichment via the NEBNext Poly(A) mRNA Magnetic Isolation Module (NEB), cDNA synthesis and sequencing library construction were carried out using the NEBNext Ultra DNA Prep Kit (NEB) along with NEBNext Multiplex Oligos, in accordance with the manufacturer’s instructions. The fragment-size distribution of the libraries was evaluated using the Bioanalyzer 2100 with the DNA high-sensitivity chip from Agilent Technologies. Prior to sequencing, library quantification was conducted using the Qubit 2.0 instrument along with the Qubit dsDNA HS Quantification Kit from ThermoFisher. For sequencing, 24 samples per lane were multiplexed on the NovaSeq X 1.5B platform, employing single-end 100 sequencing.
data_processing: The downstream analysis of demultiplexed fastq files was conducted utilizing Partek Flow (Partek, St. Louis, MO). This involved alignment to the reference genome (mm39) using the STAR aligner, followed by quantification to the HTSeq model (mm39). Gene counts underwent filtration using the "filter features by maximum ≤ 10" criterion. Normalization was performed using median ratio normalization, implemented via DESeq2. Exploratory analysis techniques such as bubble plots were employed, along with biological interpretation methods such as gene set enrichment analysis, to analyze the data and generate graphical representations. | Assembly: mm39 | Supplementary files format and content: tab-delimited text files include normalized counts for each Sample

The quality of the RNA was evaluated using a Bioanalyzer 2100 with the RNA nano chip (Agilent Technologies, Santa Clara, CA). | Following mRNA enrichment via the NEBNext Poly(A) mRNA Magnetic Isolation Module (NEB), cDNA synthesis and sequencing library construction were carried out using the NEBNext Ultra DNA Prep Kit (NEB) along with NEBNext Multiplex Oligos, in accordance with the manufacturer’s instructions. The fragment-size distribution of the libraries was evaluated using the Bioanalyzer 2100 with the DNA high-sensitivity chip from Agilent Technologies. Prior to sequencing, library quantification was conducted using the Qubit 2.0 instrument along with the Qubit dsDNA HS Quantification Kit from ThermoFisher. For sequencing, 24 samples per lane were multiplexed on the NovaSeq X 1.5B platform, employing single-end 100 sequencing.
data_processing: The downstream analysis of demultiplexed fastq files was conducted utilizing Partek Flow (Partek, St. Louis, MO). This involved alignment to the reference genome (mm39) using the STAR aligner, followed by quantification to the HTSeq model (mm39). Gene counts underwent filtration using the "filter features by maximum ≤ 10" criterion. Normalization was performed using median ratio normalization, implemented via DESeq2. Exploratory analysis techniques such as bubble plots were employed, along with biological interpretation methods such as gene set enrichment analysis, to analyze the data and generate graphical representations. | Assembly: mm39 | Supplementary files format and content: tab-delimited text files include normalized counts for each Sample
